items.description: I lead the technology strategy and the structuring of the teams and processes of Digital Channels, covering Apps, Super App, Sites, WhatsApp and Self-service. I work in close synergy with Product, guided by the pillars of speed and maximising business gains, to unlock and scale Digio's ecosystem. I accelerate the evolution of the platforms, ensuring high-impact deliveries in customer experience.

Led the Credit Products Tribe technically and operationally, managing over 40 professionals as well as architecture, Capex/Opex and OKRs, on Kubernetes. Scaled the operation from 1 squad billing R$ 5–10M/month to 4 high-performance squads — Personal Loans, BNPL, Payroll Loans and Collections — and started the Consortium team. Took Personal Loans past R$ 27M/month, the largest share of the fintech's revenue. Implemented a centralised Credit Platform that cut technical complexity, halving integrations and development time, and on top of it built and launched Payroll Loans and BNPL from scratch in just 2.5 months. Cut System Lead Time (SLT) from 50 to 12 days through cross-tribe synergy with SRE, Security, Finance and consultancies, using AI for development. Doubled deliveries, evolved the product into a Super App and migrated from Databricks to strategic insights in Google Analytics. Launched agentic squads in production, ran PoCs with WhatsApp and brought AI into Quality (Kane AI) to automate end-to-end tests in the same time as a manual test. Ran the E-NPS cycle, raising the index from 3.8 to 6.5 while ensuring talent development and a healthy environment.

Led the teams responsible for critical credit decision and collections systems (FICO, Crivo, Clear Sales) in a microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka and high-availability environment. Built a provider-agnostic credit platform for operations across multiple Latin American countries and multiple brands. Ensured 99.9% uptime on the critical credit decision and collections systems.

Directly led 3 squads owning the end-to-end vision of critical financial products such as PIX, Interest-bearing Account and Credit Card, using Kubernetes and Kafka. Set and tracked OKRs, metrics and agile processes that accelerated time-to-market of new financial features by 35%. Managed budgets for people and projects and coordinated external software factories. Implemented technical tracks, workshops, mentoring and individual development plans, consolidating a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

Oversaw the development of the white-label digital bank and the debt renegotiation systems, leading outsourced teams on microservices and Kubernetes. Enabled strategic partnerships with players such as Super Digital, Getnet and Dock for payment solutions and expansion of the financial ecosystem. Implemented a design system, increasing development productivity by 30%. Managed the software factory budget, keeping deliveries on schedule and on cost.

Led the AML (Anti-Money Laundering) squad and financial management using Kubernetes. Coordinated the integration of more than 8 teams in the creation, design and development of the AML platform responsible for capturing and monitoring every transaction in the bank. Delivered the project in 8 months, at a time when cloud did not yet exist in the bank and the SLA for a server was months.

Coordinated strategic projects in Java and .NET with bodyshop teams, using Kubernetes and managing the full cycle from discovery to production incidents in the Digital Transformation programme. Defined architecture and security requirements with corporate teams, and assessed proposals and defined scope for third-party contracting. Led selection and hiring processes, building high-performance teams and beating productivity targets. Ran strategic POCs and adopted an MVP approach to balance immediate value and scalability. Optimised budget management for development, maintenance and infrastructure.

Defined the technical architecture of the Serasa Consumidor unit together with development teams and corporate departments, using Kubernetes. Established good practices and standards with PHP and Node.js on AWS, cutting the onboarding of new developers from 2 months to 2 weeks. Ran POCs of new technologies, raising the performance and scalability of critical systems. Defined technical standards and a downstream process that cut production incidents by 40%. Wrote the reference architectural documentation standard.

Delivered a platform able to capture more than 1 billion data points in a single year, expanding the company's information asset. Pioneered disruptive technologies such as Node.js, automated testing, microservices and continuous integration (CI). Optimised processes that cut costs and reduced data acquisition time from months to days. Pioneered the adoption of cloud (AWS). Received a corporate award for technological innovation and for building the team efficiently.

Pioneered and led the company's first mobile application, coordinating squads in Java and Objective-C. Managed the process end to end, assessing proposals, hiring consultancies and defining architecture, security and budgets. Built a secure and scalable mobile architecture that became the reference standard for later applications. Validated concepts through POCs.

Technically led the architecture and maintenance of institutional sites and B2B and B2C e-commerce platforms. Implemented performance optimisations that increased loading speed by 60%. Applied SEO strategies that produced a 45% increase in organic traffic. Selected and trained developers and built scalable architectures to support transaction growth.

Acted as technical lead in the development of interfaces for classifieds and maps portals (Páginas Amarillas) across several Latin American countries. Acted as Scrum Master and as the bridge between the creative and technology areas. Developed the front-end using HTML, jQuery and CSS3, applying good practices of SEO, accessibility and usability.
Developed Universia's sites, systems and portals using Java, PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Focused on innovation and visit metrics, and handled SEO and the continuous maintenance of the portal.

Ensured quality, accessibility and usability in projects for large clients such as Vivo, Credicard, Pirelli and Porto Seguro. Optimised internal processes and signed off code against W3C standards and the clients' brand manuals.
Gathered requirements directly with internal clients. Developed prototypes, systems and tools in Java and PHP with SQL Server for the portal's content generation.
Developed applications in PHP with MySQL. Ran software tests and handled user and system administration.
Developed sites and systems using ASP and ASP.NET with a SQL Server database.
